info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Carrental Reservations Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Status API provides access to the current status of car rental reservations. Users can retrieve information about ongoing, upcoming, and past reservations, making it easier for businesses to monitor and manage their rental operations. Typical consumers of this API include rental agencies, customer service representatives, and applications that require real-time access to reservation data. This API enables efficient tracking and reporting of reservation statuses, enhancing the customer experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a reservation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current status of a specific reservation. It is useful for checking whether a reservation is confirmed, pending, or canceled.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of reservations. This body contains the necessary parameters to specify the desired status outcome.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of reservations.

ListCarrentalReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET operation on reservations status.

ListCarrentalReservationsStatusResponse_.title: Reservation Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the reservation status is successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the reservation result.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the reservation status.

audit.description: Information related to the creation and automation of the reservation.

ListCarrentalReservationsStatusResponse_.description: Schema representing the response of a GET operation that retrieves the status of a reservation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the reservation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the reservation creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit details associated with a reservation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value typically signifies better performance.
